name: How do I compare electricians or subcontractors when the project has a lot of moving parts?

mainEntity.name: How do I compare electricians or subcontractors when the project has a lot of moving parts?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should compare how each contractor handles sequencing, communication, and inspection readiness, not just labor price. A strong electrical coordinator will confirm handoff dates, identify conflicts early, and keep the other trades informed about access needs and rough-in completion. That matters more than a low bid if your project is on a tight timeline or has multiple active crews.
acceptedAnswer.description: Compare how they manage scheduling, communication, and inspection readiness, not just the quoted price.
